title: BONE
body_html:
Introducing the most advanced Golf Glove ever made; engineered with the highest quality materials & AAA premium leather creating an unparalleled sensation, fit and feel. Paired with our signature GHOSTGOLF rubber logo and pull tab making this the most stylish tour-player glove. 

Tech Features:

  • Premium AAA 100% Cabretta Leather: This golf glove is made from the finest materials, offering a premium look and feel.
  • Soft Feel and Excellent Grip: The soft feel of the leather, combined with its excellent grip, provides the ultimate in comfort and performance on the course.
  • Perforated and Stretch Zones: The perforated and stretch zones optimize breathability and flexibility, ensuring a comfortable fit during play.
  • Dry Cuff Lining: The dry cuff lining ensures quick-drying and moisture-wicking around the wrist, keeping your hands dry and comfortable.
  • Signature GHOSTGOLF Pull Tab: The signature GHOSTGOLF pull tab makes it easy to put on and take off the glove.
  • USGA Conforming: This golf glove meets the highest standards in golf, as it is USGA conforming.
  • California Proposition 65 Notice: ⚠️ This product and its packaging may expose you to chemicals known to the State of California to cause cancer and reproductive harm. For more information, visit www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
  • Need help sizing? See glove size guide below

title: GHOSTGOLF™ PERFORMANCE GOLF SOCK (BLK)
body_html:
The GHOSTGOLF™ Performance Golf Sock combines sweat-wicking performance yarns, targeted arch compression, and asymmetric cushioning for comfort and support throughout your round.

Designed to work with your golf shoe, its traction footbed helps enhance grip inside the shoe, while strategically placed cushioning supports the natural shape and pressure zones of each foot. From the first tee to the final putt, every detail is built for a comfortable, secure fit.

FEATURES

  • Traction Footbed — Engineered to enhance grip inside your golf shoe for added stability and control.
  • Custom-Blended Performance Yarns — Help manage moisture for comfort throughout the round.
  • Targeted Arch Compression — Provides supportive compression and helps keep the sock securely in place.
  • Asymmetric Cushioned Footbed — Cushioning follows the natural shape and pressure zones of each foot for targeted comfort and support.
  • Signature Branding — Knit GHOSTGOLF™ branding across the top of the foot delivers a clean, distinctive finish.

MATERIALS

65% Nylon / 27% Polyester / 4% Elastane / 4% Cotton

Underfoot, the PMXSpeed PLT propulsion plate and TPU outsole provide stability, energy return, and three-dimensional traction throughout your swing.

  • CLARINO Trivela™ microfiber upper
  • WATERPROOF+ breathable membrane with sealed bottom gasket
  • ARIAPRENE® tongue and bootie for secure foot lockdown
  • PMXNITROGEN+ midsole for energy return and support
  • ORTHOLITE footbed for lasting cushioning and comfort
  • PMXSpeed PLT propulsion plate
  • TPU outsole with three-dimensional traction

PAYNTR GOLF x GHOSTGOLF™
Built for golfers who demand performance without compromise.

title: GHOSTGOLF FLAG HAT
body_html:
The GHOSTGOLF FLAG HAT blends tactical-inspired styling with modern golf performance, creating a clean, understated look built for both the course and everyday wear. Constructed from lightweight, water-resistant performance fabric, this hat delivers durability, comfort, and versatility in any condition.

Featuring a custom black-on-black Ghost Golf patch on the front panel and a tonal American flag patch on the side, the design takes inspiration from military squadron insignias while maintaining a refined, stealth aesthetic. Perforated side panels enhance airflow, while the moisture-wicking sweatband and structured fit provide all-day comfort from the first tee to the last.

Whether you're traveling, practicing, or playing a competitive round, the GHOSTGOLF FLAG HAT delivers premium performance, understated style, and the mission-ready attitude that defines the DOGFIGHT Collection.

Product Features:

  • Style: Performance Snapback with custom Ghost Golf patch
  • Material: Lightweight water-resistant performance fabric
  • Detailing: Tonal American flag side patch
  • Breathability: Laser-perforated side panels for enhanced airflow
  • Sweatband: Moisture-wicking sweatband for all-day comfort
  • Fit: Adjustable snapback closure
  • Profile: Structured mid-crown silhouette
  • Visor: Curved brim for a modern athletic look
  • Size: One Size Fits Most (OSFM)

title: DOGFIGHT FLAG TEE
body_html:
Designed for everyday comfort with a military-inspired attitude, the DOGFIGHT FLAG TEE brings together premium materials, modern fit, and signature Ghost Golf style. Crafted from a soft, breathable cotton blend, it delivers all-day comfort whether you're heading to the course, the clubhouse, or anywhere in between.

Featuring a premium embroidered squadron-inspired chest patch and a subtle embroidered Ghost Golf lightning bolt graphic on the back, this tee draws inspiration from aviation heritage and the camaraderie found within elite fighter squadrons. The relaxed fit and premium construction create an effortless look that pairs easily with your favorite golf shorts, joggers, or everyday essentials.

Whether you're teeing it up for a competitive round or simply embracing the lifestyle beyond the course, the DOGFIGHT FLAG TEE delivers versatile comfort, premium quality, and a design inspired by those who play with confidence, precision, and purpose.

Fit: Classic fit.
Fabric: 70% Cotton / 30% Polyester
Details: Woven Ghost Golf Icon label at right hem.
Care Instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors on a gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low heat. If needed, iron on low temperature.

title: AWOL® GOLF TRAVEL BAG DOGFIGHT G-SUIT EDITION
body_html:
Mission Ready. Built to Deploy.

Inspired by the flight suits worn by elite fighter pilots, the AWOL® Golf Travel Bag – DOGFIGHT G-SUIT Edition combines military-inspired design with premium protection for golfers who travel without compromise.

Finished in an exclusive G-SUIT colorway with embroidered squadron patches, utility-inspired detailing, and premium hardware, this limited-edition travel bag is built to protect your clubs from the baggage carousel to the first tee.

Travel Bag Specifications

Club Pro (Fits Stand & Cart Bags)

  • Weight: 8.5 lbs

Features

  • Limited Edition DOGFIGHT G-SUIT design
  • Premium Tour Grade abrasion-resistant nylon construction
  • Premium YKK® zippers for smooth, reliable performance
  • Wrap-around foam padding for superior club protection

  • D-shaped full-opening design for easy packing

title: CLUB DEFENDER
body_html:
Protect your golf clubs like a pro with the Ghost Golf Club Defender. Engineered for maximum impact resistance, this portable golf club stiff arm protector is designed to safeguard your clubs against the bumps and jolts of travel. The Defender features a reinforced rubber and ABS hard plastic support top, ensuring superior vibration resistance to keep your clubs safe.

Crafted from lightweight, durable aluminum alloy, this support rod is fully adjustable with 15 height settings, expanding up to 55 inches and collapsing to a compact 20 inches to fit most golf travel bags. The Defender’s smooth, telescopic design includes an easy-to-use push-button mechanism, making it convenient to maneuver, assemble, and store.

Whether you're a seasoned traveler or just hitting the road for a weekend tournament, the Ghost Golf Club Defender provides unparalleled protection and peace of mind for your most valuable gear. Keep your clubs safe and your focus on the game, no matter where your passion for golf takes you!

Water-Resistant Exterior: Helps protect your essentials from light rain, spills, and course conditions.
Velour Soft Lining: Interior lining helps safeguard valuables like your phone, rangefinder, or accessories from scratches.
Secure Attachment Carabiner: Easily clips onto your golf bag for quick access during your round.
Organized Storage: Includes one zippered compartment and one snap-button pocket to separate and secure tees, ball markers, gloves, scorecards, or small valuables.
Durable Construction: Built with high-quality materials designed to withstand regular use on and off the course.
A compact, functional solution for carrying your golf essentials.

body_html:
Introducing the Ghost Golf Clubhouse Hoodie. Made from premium 420 GSM French Terry, this hoodie offers the perfect blend of comfort, breathability, and durability — your go-to layer on and off the course.

Designed with a classic fit and ribbed waistband for a clean, tapered silhouette, the Clubhouse Hoodie combines performance with everyday style. A subtle chest logo and a Ghost Golf silicone sleeve label add a refined touch without being loud. The kangaroo pocket includes a discreet zip pocket for secure storage, while a snap-closure hood eliminates drawcords that might get in the way of your swing.

Whether you're gearing up for the first tee or relaxing at the clubhouse, this hoodie delivers confidence and comfort in every moment.

Fit: Classic Fit
Fabric: 85% Cotton / 15% Polyester – 420 GSM French Terry
Care: Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Cool iron if needed.

title: RANGE PRO LONG SLEEVE POLO
body_html:
Introducing the Range Pro Long Sleeve Polo — Ghost Golf’s first-ever long sleeve performance polo, built for sunny days and serious play.

Crafted from a high-quality polyester-spandex knit with a distinctive waffle weave texture, this innovative 2-in-1 design delivers lightweight sun protection without compromising comfort or mobility. The integrated long sleeves use self-fabric construction for a seamless, bulk-free fit, while a modern snap-button placket adds a sharp, athletic finish.

A slightly curved back hem ensures a clean look whether tucked or untucked, and the stretch-enhanced fabric moves with you — never against you. This polo is designed for golfers who demand both style and performance every round.

Fit: Classic Fit
Fabric: 91% Polyester / 9% Spandex – Waffle Weave Knit
Care: Machine wash cold with like colors. Gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Cool iron if needed.

The Original Patented GHOSTGOLF® Magnetic Towel

Features:

  • Patented Magnetic Design: Our concealed, powerful magnet lets the towel attach securely to your golf cart or other metal surfaces. Drop it greenside and easily pick it back up with your club or putter—no bending down required.

  • Oversized 18" x 40" Design: More surface area means more room to clean, wipe, and dry your gear while keeping different sections of the towel ready for different jobs.
  • Easy to Clean: Machine wash and air dry. Simple.

Original. Patented. Made by golfers, for golfers.
